card.name: moss-and-oak
card.description: Moss & Oak: simple, well-made furniture with only the parts you need, at fair prices. Eco-friendly materials, an inclusive workshop, every receipt signed. Desk lamps, chairs and bookshelves. Receipts: Ed25519 sig_seller over {shop, item, price, task}. Each reply ends with our current price as its only number; 'Final price' means we cannot go lower. Up to six offers, and we say how many remain. Reply 'accept' to buy at the current price, 'help' for the rules. Every buyer gets a member code with the receipt; members get lower prices next time.

skills.name: Negotiate a purchase
skills.description: Ask for an item, then send a price as a number or reply 'accept'. The shop answers with a counteroffer (the only number in its message, also in a data Part {ask, final, offers_left}), a signed receipt artifact, or a rejection after six offers.
